about_the_game:
Ghost Circuit is a first-person exploration and stealth game about urban trespass and the stories buried beneath forgotten structures.

You play as Kalen, a lone urban explorer drawn to the silence of abandoned industrial sites. These are places no one talks about. Towers left unfinished. Facilities evacuated without notice. Some are decades old. Some feel like everyone left yesterday. Surveillance systems still hum quietly in the dark.

At first, you are just there to see what was left behind. Then you find a radio. And someone answers.

Features

Explore large, handcrafted environments

Climb scaffolding, cross exposed beams, scale industrial structures, and navigate layered spaces built for movement and vertical discovery. Each location is designed to reward patience, observation, and curiosity.

Focus on stealth and precision

Every step you take matters. Navigate unstable structures, avoid surveillance, and rely on your awareness to stay hidden. Movement is your only defense, and the environment is always watching.

Immersive first-person traversal

Move like a real explorer. Climb scaffolding, shimmy across ledges, balance on narrow beams, and pull yourself through tight spaces. The environment tests your body and your focus.

Document a hidden story

Collect lost materials, take photos, and uncover pieces of a quiet narrative tied to a powerful corporate entity called Noventis. What connects all of these sites is not immediately clear, but the truth is scattered throughout the architecture.

A voice on the radio

Lena helps you find your way through these forgotten structures. She offers guidance, context, and insight into the places you explore and into the larger mystery that ties them together.


Ghost Circuit is about the thrill of going where you are not supposed to and learning why no one ever came back.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB or AMD RX 580 8GB
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6700 XT
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
